svg.title: Measured motion replay: held and rolling acquisition

cc:Work.dc:title: Measured motion replay: held and rolling acquisition
cc:Work.dc:description: Original baseline: 400,000 emissions over a two-second high-motion MoCap segment in an exact static room; 1 ms pose boundaries. MuJoCo rolling origin bound 0.5 mm. Range agreement with an interpolated measured-pose reference, not hardware precision.
